sessions.phase_label: Project scoping and iOS screenshot design
Screenshot review, feature graphic revision, and asset delivery

requirements.title: Eight iOS Phone Screenshots
requirements.definition: Produce a set of eight screenshots for the iOS phone presentation, excluding an iPad version.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the screenshot-set quantity and device scope only; independently reviewable content constraints for individual screenshots remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Updated Source Image for Screenshot 02
requirements.definition: Use the client's newly attached image in place of the earlier 02-ai-skipping.png source image.
requirements.boundary_note: The source-image substitution can be completed or revised independently of Screenshot 02's content-label and kissing-depiction constraints.

requirements.title: Appropriate Facial Expressions in Screenshot 01
requirements.definition: Depict facial expressions in the first screenshot that do not appear inappropriately upset or sad.
requirements.boundary_note: This visual acceptance condition applies only to Screenshot 01 and can be reviewed independently of the other screenshot edits.

requirements.title: Content Filter Labels in Screenshot 02
requirements.definition: Remove the violence content pill while retaining the nudity, kissing, and profanity pills in Screenshot 02.
requirements.boundary_note: The set of displayed content-filter labels is independently modifiable and testable from the screenshot's photographic depiction.

requirements.title: Non-Explicit Kissing Depiction in Screenshot 02
requirements.definition: Hide the photograph showing active kissing or replace it with an image that implies kissing without depicting the act.
requirements.boundary_note: The photographic depiction has its own acceptance criterion and can change independently of the neighboring content-filter labels.

requirements.title: Google TV Support Depiction in Screenshot 06
requirements.definition: Use Screenshot 06 to demonstrate that the app can be watched on any Google TV device.
requirements.boundary_note: This screenshot communicates a distinct device-support capability and can be revised or accepted independently of the other screenshot content.

requirements.title: Android Play Store Feature Graphic
requirements.definition: Produce a 1024x500 Play Store feature graphic with the approved brand copy and logo arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Graphic dimensions, tagline text, supporting text, and logo positioning are attributes of one independently delivered feature graphic rather than separate Requirements.
